authority: Owner 2026-09-29: The Long Game H2 greenlit ('go ahead'); answer 23 'Fights everyday, depending on the mission. Maybe 2 per day.' A door is an offer on a block the spine leaves free: taking one costs the block. Templates, not scenes.
fiction_boundary: Composite people and situations. The good is abstract (DESIGN_LOCKS §9.1).

rules.note: A late door closes when the block clock passes 22:00 (road minutes). While fewer than fights_per_day_max fights have happened today, every door block offers at least one door that can become a fight. A door is taken once per chapter.
rules.escalation_note: Answer 25: fights are central and escalate easily from bad deals. A choice with `escalates` rolls once (deterministic from the save); on a bad roll the door's own fight starts if the crew is there, and if it is not, the door's fight.lose is paid instead. It never escalates past the day's two fights. The forecast always says so.

templates.title: Rauno's Cart
templates.premise: The bottle collector's cart has lost a wheel halfway up the Harju hill. Four hundred bottles, one wheel, and the return point shuts at nine.
steps: Find the wheel under the tram stop bench
Push the cart up the hill
Stand in line while Rauno counts every bottle twice
templates.stakes: A few euros, and a man who knows every back door owes you one.
inspectables: a wheel with a sock tied round the axle
four hundred bottles sorted by colour
Rauno's tally in pencil on his arm

choices.label: Push it up the hill
choices.forecast: €20, and Rauno owes you.

choices.label: Push it, and ask what he has seen
choices.forecast: €10 and one thing worth knowing.

choices.label: Tell him the hill will still be there tomorrow
choices.forecast: Nothing, and Rauno remembers.

templates.title: The Queue Sitter
templates.premise: A pensioner in a fur hat pays by the hour to have his place in the bank queue kept while he argues with the teller about markka. He argues for a long time.
steps: Take his ticket
Keep his place without looking like you are
Hand it back when the teller gives up
templates.stakes: Clean money. Nobody fights in a bank queue.
inspectables: ticket 41
a biscuit tin full of markka
the teller's third cup of coffee

choices.label: Hold his place
Hold it, and listen to the argument
choices.forecast: €15, and you learn how a markka tin turns into euros.

choices.label: Give the ticket to someone who needs it
choices.forecast: Nothing.

templates.title: Crates Under the Fish Stall
templates.premise: Mei Lan's cousin needs three crates moved from under a fish stall before the market inspector's second round. The crates are heavier than fish.
steps: Wait for the inspector to pass once
Carry the crates to the van behind the market hall
Do not open them
templates.stakes: The Jade Lantern pays and remembers. Skim one and it can become a fight: the cousin's men catch up with you at the bear · a way round exists.
inspectables: ice melting on the crates
the inspector's clipboard
the cousin counting on his fingers

choices.label: Carry all three
choices.forecast: €40, and the Jade Lantern thinks better of you.

choices.label: Carry two, keep one
choices.forecast: A pack for yourself. Half the time they count before you are out of the park, and it becomes a fight at the bear.

choices.label: Tell the cousin the inspector is coming back
choices.forecast: Nothing, but a warning is worth something.

templates.title: The Van With No Seats
templates.premise: The McCormicks need a van driven from the Linjat yard to Siltanen with its back doors taped shut. The driver quit this morning. Nobody says why.
steps: Take the keys from the man by the skip
Drive it the long way round
Leave it with the doors still taped
templates.stakes: McCormick money, McCormick attention. Look inside and it can become a fight in a Torkkelinmäki courtyard · a way round exists.
inspectables: tape over the back doors
a child seat in the front
the keys on a Hartwall bottle opener

choices.label: Drive it the long way
choices.forecast: €55 and a friend at the yard. Heat at Linjat.

choices.label: Peel back the tape at a red light
choices.forecast: You know what is in it. They will know you looked, and a third of the time they corner you in a courtyard: a fight.

choices.label: Give the keys back
choices.forecast: Nothing.

templates.title: The Bag at the Boiler Hall
templates.premise: A bag waits behind the old boiler hall at Suvilahti. So, the McCormicks hear, does a crew that wants it more than they do.
steps: Come in by the gas holders
Take the bag from the loading bay
Leave before anyone decides it is theirs
templates.stakes: Can become a fight · a way round exists.
inspectables: footprints in the coal dust
a radio playing to nobody
three bikes that do not belong to kids

choices.label: Slip in by the gas holders
choices.forecast: €45 if nobody is looking. A third of the time somebody is, and it becomes a fight.

choices.label: Walk in through the front with the crew
choices.forecast: A fight for the bag. Win it and the McCormicks pay double.

choices.label: Tell the McCormicks the bag is spoken for
choices.forecast: Nothing, and they think less of you.

templates.title: The Quay Shift
templates.premise: The night shift at the Sörnäinen quay buys at shift change, in the gap between one foreman leaving and the next arriving.
steps: Be at the gate at changeover
Sell to the one in the orange jacket, not the one in yellow
Gone before the next foreman
templates.stakes: A better price than the square. Stay too long and it can become a fight: the yellow jacket's friends follow you to the boiler hall · a way round exists.
inspectables: an orange jacket and a yellow one
a crane moving with nobody in it
the gate's broken clock

choices.label: Sell one to the orange jacket
Sell two, and stay a minute too long
choices.forecast: €90, and the harbour gets hotter. Four times in ten the yellow jacket's friends follow you, and it becomes a fight.

choices.label: Walk past the gate
choices.forecast: Nothing.

templates.title: The Back Room at Scene Club
templates.premise: A painter at Scene Club wants to buy, quietly, in the room behind Jaska's. Jaska's door is open.
steps: Go in through the kitchen
Sell in the back room
Decide whether Jaska sees you
templates.stakes: Easy money, twenty metres from your brother.
inspectables: wet canvases facing the wall
Jaska's radio through the partition
a receipt pinned to the door frame

choices.label: Sell in the back room
choices.forecast: €38. Jaska hears it.

choices.label: Take the painter outside first
choices.forecast: €30, and your brother keeps his room.

choices.label: Say hello to Jaska instead
choices.forecast: Nothing to sell tonight. Jaska is glad.

templates.title: The Buyer at the Bear
templates.premise: A buyer wants two packs at the granite bear after dark. He says he is coming alone. He says it twice.
steps: Meet him at the bear
Count his money before he counts yours
Watch the path behind him
templates.stakes: Can become a fight · a way round exists.
inspectables: cigarette ends behind the bear
his new trainers
the path lamp that is out

choices.label: Sell one and keep your eyes on the path
choices.forecast: €50. A quarter of the time his friends come out anyway, and it becomes a fight.

choices.label: Let his friends come out, with your crew beside you
choices.forecast: A fight at the bear. Win it and you keep their money.

choices.label: Tell him you are not coming alone either
choices.forecast: No sale.

templates.title: Broth for the Old Man Upstairs
templates.premise: Toko wants a pot of broth carried upstairs to a man who has not left his flat since the markka went. Toko does not say who he is.
steps: Carry the pot up four floors
Knock twice, then once
Listen to whatever he wants to say
templates.stakes: No money. Toko trusts you with more.
inspectables: the pot's lid tied down with string
a door with no name
a stack of old tram tickets

choices.label: Carry it up and stay for the story
choices.forecast: Toko trusts you more, and the old man knew the 3 in 1991.

choices.label: Carry it up and leave it at the door
choices.forecast: Toko nods.

choices.label: Say you have work
choices.forecast: Toko says nothing, which is worse.

templates.title: A Name for the McCormicks
templates.premise: The McCormicks want one name: whoever has been buying on their corner for the Jade Lantern. They think you know it. You might.
steps: Hear the question
Decide what you know
Live with the answer
templates.stakes: A family's goodwill against the other family's. A false name can become a fight the night they check · a way round exists.
inspectables: a list of names with two crossed out
a kettle nobody has filled
the brothers not looking at each other

choices.label: Give them a name
choices.forecast: The McCormicks like you. The Jade Lantern will hear.

choices.label: Give them a name that is nobody's
choices.forecast: They pay €40 for it. Three times in ten they check the same night, and it becomes a fight.

choices.label: Say you sell, you do not watch
choices.forecast: Nothing, and the kettle stays empty.

templates.title: Watch Car 41
templates.premise: The 3 comes through Piritori every eight minutes. Car 41 comes through when it likes. Watch it for one evening.
steps: Stand where Kello used to stand
Count who gets on 41 and who only pretends to
Write nothing down
templates.stakes: Something worth knowing. The square notices a new watcher.
inspectables: car 41's scratched window
a man who rides one stop and back
the tram driver's thermos

choices.label: Watch the whole evening
choices.forecast: You learn who rides 41 now.

choices.label: Get on 41 and ride it to the end
choices.forecast: You learn where it goes. The man who rides one stop sees you.

choices.label: Let the trams go by
choices.forecast: Nothing.

templates.title: The Back Door at Hakaniemi
templates.premise: After ten the Jade Lantern's back door opens for people who are not customers. Mei Lan would like to know who. So would everyone else.
steps: Find a window with a view of the door
Time who goes in and who comes out
Decide who hears it
templates.stakes: Worth something to either family. Selling it can become a fight on the way home · a way round exists. A late door: gone after 22:00.
inspectables: a door wedged with a chopstick
a delivery bike with no deliveries
the same cough twice

choices.label: Time it for Mei Lan
choices.forecast: The Jade Lantern trusts you.

choices.label: Time it and sell it to the McCormicks
choices.forecast: €45 from the McCormicks. Three times in ten Mei Lan's people see you leave the yard, and it becomes a fight.

choices.label: Go home before ten
choices.forecast: Nothing.

templates.title: The Debt at the Bear
templates.premise: A man owes the McCormicks and sits at the granite bear every night as if daring them. They would rather it was not them who went.
steps: Find him at the bear
Ask once
Decide what asking twice looks like
templates.stakes: Can become a fight · a way round exists.
inspectables: a thermos with no tea in it
two friends pretending to feed ducks
a bear with a new scratch

choices.label: Talk him into paying
choices.forecast: €60, if you know enough about him. One time in five his friends stop feeding the ducks anyway, and it becomes a fight.

choices.label: Lean on him, with the crew
choices.forecast: His friends stop feeding the ducks. A fight at the bear.

choices.label: Tell the McCormicks to go themselves
choices.forecast: They will remember who said no.

templates.title: The Card Game's Ledger
templates.premise: A card game in a Torkkelinmäki courtyard keeps a ledger of who owes the Jade Lantern. Mei Lan wants it gone before morning. The players want it where it is.
steps: Get into the courtyard
Get the ledger off the table
Get out
templates.stakes: Can become a fight · a way round exists. A late door: gone after 22:00.
inspectables: a ledger under an ashtray
a player who never looks at his cards
washing lines across the courtyard

choices.label: Buy into the game and lose the ledger on purpose
choices.forecast: €50 for a seat. The ledger leaves with you, unless the player who never looks at his cards looks at you: a quarter of the time, a fight.

choices.label: Take it off the table, with the crew
choices.forecast: The players stand up. A fight in the courtyard.

choices.label: Tell Mei Lan the ledger is a bad idea
choices.forecast: Mei Lan will find someone else.
